apps.localizedDescription: A fast, controller-friendly launcher that runs Windows games on iOS and iPadOS with Steam and GOG built in, powered by Wine, FEX and Metal via DXMT.

versions.localizedDescription:
**BCD is in alpha:** an early stage of development, before beta. Many games run, many do not yet, and things can break between builds. When a game fails, please send a log.

## 🎮 New: Steam DLC

- **BCD now installs the DLC you own.** Before a game's first install, BCD asks Steam which DLC you own for it and lets you choose them, each with its size (**Choose your DLC**), or install the game alone. It asks every time you install.
- **Manage DLC after the install:** the game's page lists your DLC. Switch each one on or off and **Apply** downloads or removes it, or use **Install all your DLC**. DLC you do not own is listed under *Not in your library*.

## 🛒 New: Epic Games Store (early)

- **Sign in with your Epic account** in **Settings › Accounts**; your Epic games appear in the library with their covers.
- **If the first sign-in stops at a step on Epic's side:** Epic sometimes needs you to accept an updated privacy policy or terms, or to answer an account question, before it lets an app sign in. BCD then says *"Epic wants you to finish a step on its website"*. Open epicgames.com in Safari (or any browser), sign in there and complete the step, then come back to BCD and sign in again.
- **Install and play:** BCD downloads and installs your Epic games and starts them signed in to your account (through a small helper, BCD Host), so a game that checks with Epic that you own it starts as it does on a PC. Starting such a game needs an internet connection.
- **Before Install, BCD says when a game cannot run:** games with Easy Anti-Cheat, and games that start through another company's launcher (for example Ubisoft's). **Grand Theft Auto V:** its anti-cheat (BattlEye) guards only GTA Online, so BCD starts the game with its own `-nobattleye` option: Story Mode plays, GTA Online stays off.
- **Not yet:** game updates and repair, Epic cloud saves, and the Epic sign-in page some games show inside the game the first time.

## Other improvements

> **Tried one of these games on an earlier build? Reset its settings first.** A game keeps the settings it had until you reset them, so without this it may start with the old ones that failed. On the game's page: **Options › Recommended settings › Reset to Recommended**, then check that **Options › Auto-tune › Auto-tune this game** is on, and start the game again.

These fix failures found in the logs you sent with Send Log since 0.1.580. Each fix targets the error a log showed; most could not be tested on a device yet, so a game may now get further and still stop at a later point. If it does, please send a new log: it names the next problem.

- **"Microsoft Visual C++ 2015-2022 Redistributable (arm64)" at start** (Unreal Engine games: Dead as Disco, TUNG, Denshattack!, FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE demo): BCD now reports a current version of that runtime, so newer games accept it, and auto-tune tries again for games where the earlier fix did not help. Thanks to le0-VV (#13).
- **Steam downloads:** each downloaded piece is checked against Steam's checksum, and where Steam offers no secure (HTTPS) download server in your region, BCD now uses Steam's other servers instead of failing (pieces from those are always checked). Thanks to vancez (#11).
- **Resident Evil Requiem, Life is Strange Remastered, Life is Strange 2:** the game could not load its main program at start; their recommended settings now make room for it.
- **Grand Theft Auto IV (Steam):** Rockstar's launcher stopped before the game; its recommended settings now give Social Club's browser the memory layout it asks for.
- **SpiderHeck, ROUNDS, PlateUp!:** BCD ended these games while they were still running, mistaking a burst of the game's own handled errors for a crash loop; their recommended settings now let BCD tell the two apart.
- **FINAL FANTASY TACTICS - The Ivalice Chronicles:** the game stopped at start asking for more address space than the device has; its recommended settings now report a smaller space to it.
- **Horizon Zero Dawn and Age of Empires II HD in BCD Dock:** the game closed at once for want of Microsoft's MFC library; in BCD Dock it is now provided for them (from the Visual C++ runtime download in Settings).
- **Fallout: New Vegas in BCD Dock:** the launcher said the game was not installed; BCD now writes the registry entries Steam's installer writes on Windows.
- **Digimon Story Cyber Sleuth, FINAL FANTASY XV demo, Borderlands 3, Zenless Zone Zero:** the game closed at start for a missing Windows library; their recommended settings now add it.
- **Jetboard Joust:** stopped at start; its recommended settings now hand the memory operation that blocked .NET to the emulator.
- **Sword and Fairy 3** (and other games that use Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Thai or Central and Eastern European code pages): BCD now ships those Windows code page tables; Sword and Fairy 3's recommended settings turn them on.
- **Project Zomboid:** Java's memory manager asked for address space a phone does not have; the recommended settings switch Java to another one.
- **A Plague Tale: Innocence:** BCD itself closed when the game decrypted data of an unexpected length; the game now gets an error instead, as on Windows.
- **A memory-mapping clash** no longer ends a game with an internal error; the game gets an error it can handle.
- **Auto-tune:** handles larger programs that must load at a fixed address (512-720 MB); recognises self-modifying-code loops in more 32-bit games (PES 2013); no longer suggests a swap file when memory was not the cause (Albino Lullaby) and can raise the recommended swap after a memory kill (GTA V Enhanced on 12 GB devices); tries turning video decoding off for a crash during an intro video; names a Steam copy-protection failure (error 55) instead of retrying; no longer counts a normal quit as a hang; and leaves Steam's helper programs and installers alone.
- **The app icon** now follows iOS dark and tinted modes.
- **Game settings editor:** on a phone held sideways, Save and Cancel sit above the text, and your text survives turning the phone.
- **Memory note:** the game page now names only the Increased Memory Limit (extended virtual addressing made no difference in the logs).
- **Send Log:** logs name more causes (the type of a C++ error a game threw, missing code pages, older Steam start-up messages, the Steam install script's registry values).

Install help, game reports and ideas: the BCD-Games Discord is open, https://discord.gg/43TmupTVug

**BCD.ipa**: the unsigned IPA, for sideloading with SideStore, AltStore or LiveContainer. It needs iOS 18 or later and JIT; the README has the details.
**BCD-source.tar.xz**: the complete source of this build with all its submodules (GPL-3.0).
